note: Exp required to complete a given battlepass level. Formula from GlobalMethods.getPlayerLevelExpReq(currLevel). Each scaling threshold multiplies the running total (roundFloatToInt at the end, not per-step).
formula: base = 50 * level * level; if level > 35: base *= (1 + (level - 35) * 0.05); if level > 50: base *= (1 + (level - 50) * 0.05); if level > 75: base *= (1 + (level - 75) * 0.05); if level > 100: base *= (1 + (level - 100) * 0.05); if level > 125: base *= (1 + (level - 125) * 0.05); result = round_half_up(base)
